keyframe_review.note: New keyframe after 'the fall of the nearby city Cholula (c. 650 – 750)'; a 30 km radius is the researcher's reading of 'this part of the Tlaxcala–Puebla valley'. The cholula dossier removes this circle from its own shape for 750–900. Repair: Cholula's 10 km city circle (1 cell) is excluded, since the Cholula page makes the city the Olmeca-Xicallanca capital (700-1200); 9 cells instead of 10. The Cacaxtla page's undated 'Warriors from Cacaxtla appear to have taken over Cholula for a time' is not drawn.

ledger.note: 650: Cacaxtla and Xochitécatl rise under the Olmeca-Xicalanca. 'Cacaxtla and Xochitecatl prospered 650–900 CE'; the Olmeca-Xicalanca 'inhabited Cacaxtla between the years 600 and 900 AD' and were 'perhaps Maya settlers who arrived in this part of central Mexico around 400 CE'. The year is the page's; the 10 km core is the researcher's. Counterpart cholula (review fix): the core's capital cell lay inside Cholula's 25 km circle; mirror of cholula /ledger/1 (650 loss).

notes: Added at the orchestrator's request (Cliopatria lacks Cacaxtla). The page gives no founding year and no coordinates (gazetteer coordinates used), no territorial extent beyond 'this part of the Tlaxcala–Puebla valley', and no successor. The Olmeca-Xicalanca page adds only 'after the seventh century' and that they are believed to have built Cacaxtla. Xochitécatl's own page was not opened (budget). Overlap with cholula is handled by subtraction in both dossiers (Cholula 750–900 = Cholula km 25 minus Cacaxtla km 30). Wikidata id unknown. REPAIR 2026-10-18: /ledger/0 counterpart nobody -> cholula (cholula's 650 loss is its mirror); the 30 km hegemonic land of the 750 keyframe, the 750 gain, the 900 dissolve and the successor entry now exclude Cholula's 10 km city circle, so the city of Cholula is not drawn as Cacaxtla's. The page's undated 'Warriors from Cacaxtla appear to have taken over Cholula for a time, but they were ultimately expelled by the Toltecs' is not drawn.
